text: The Patriots head to Buffalo for Week 4 facing a depleted defensive line, as both Christian Gonzalez and Christian Barmore have been ruled out with shoulder injuries, forcing Mike Reiss to break down how New England will manage replacements against Josh Allen and the Bills. On the offensive side, the infrastructure around Drake Maye continues to crumble—guard Greg Van Roten was placed on injured reserve with a thigh injury, though Maye himself insists his right shoulder is fine and emphasized the need for better decision-making rather than physical limitations as he battles early-season struggles in the Patriots' 1-2 start. The good news comes from the off-field front, where wide receiver Mack Hollins was named the Week 4 NFLPA Community MVP after hosting a Special Olympics Family Field Day for over 125 athletes and their families. Meanwhile, offensive lineman Matt Pryor gets set to join the Patriots offense, and expert predictions are in for what figures to be a crucial divisional matchup against a Bills team looking to capitalize on the turnover-prone Maye and a Patriots squad that's leaning heavily on replacements at multiple levels.
